SOURCE=c7365c9fbb7ff8bb004229b71f948619a864c4bd

trap 'rm -rf -- "$run_dir"' EXIT
curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chreece/shadPS4/$RUNNER/scripts/shadps4-universal-two-game-check.sh" \
  -o "$run_dir/run.sh"

  7b938ffc328a72bffc9b1cc71b470bb6767b11fe43d5667114cba53075dce733 \
  "$run_dir/run.sh" | sha256sum --check -
unset SHADPS4_PR117_CAPTURE_ONCE
SHADPS4_TEST_PERFORMANCE=1 SHADPS4_TEST_FIRST_GAME=CUSA34384 bash "$run_dir/run.sh" "$SOURCE" build "$RUNNER"
